consent.title: Together, we'll go the distance 🌿
consent.description:
We have a simple wish: for this app to stay with you for the long run, growing steadier with every step.

Along the way, it may stumble from time to time. And we'd like to be the one who gently helps it back up.
That's why we want to collect a little crash log — just the technical details from the moment something goes wrong, so we can find the issue and keep moving forward.

Rest assured: your privacy stays completely untouched.

These logs are used only to improve your experience, and you can turn them off anytime in Settings → About.

If you have any thoughts or run into any trouble, feel free to write to us at [zuorn@qq.com](mailto:zuorn@qq.com).
Every word you share means a lot to us.

privacyPolicy.title: Tydora Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains what data Tydora collects, why we collect it, and how you can manage it.
privacyPolicy.collectBody:
After you opt in, Tydora anonymously collects the following usage data:
• Feature usage events: app launch/exit, theme switches, editor modes, exports and publishing, opening mind maps/graphs/canvas, bookmark and tag operations, etc.
• Device technical info: operating system, app version, and UI language.
• A randomly generated installation instance ID: used to approximate unique visitor counts. It contains no personal information.
privacyPolicy.notCollectBody: We never collect your note contents, file names, file paths, images or attachment contents, nor any personally identifiable information such as your name, email, account, location, or contacts.
privacyPolicy.whyBody: This data helps us understand which features are used most and where problems occur, so we can prioritize improvements to stability and reduce crashes and lag.
privacyPolicy.storageBody: Statistics are sent over an encrypted connection to the Umami cloud analytics service (cloud.umami.is). Umami is an open-source, privacy-friendly analytics tool. We never sell or share this data with any third party.
privacyPolicy.controlBody: You can turn off analytics anytime in Settings → About → Together, we'll go the distance. Once disabled, the app sends no further data; previously collected statistics are not retroactively deleted.
privacyPolicy.contactBody: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, feel free to write to us at [zuorn@qq.com](mailto:zuorn@qq.com), or open an issue in the [GitHub repository zuorn/Tydora](https://github.com/zuorn/Tydora).

xhs.title: Export Cards
xhs.gridLinesHint: Show composition grid lines on cards to check layout and content overflow
xhs.sourceModeHint: Switch to Instant Render to preview live
xhs.helpIntro: "Export Cards" renders the current document into card images and exports them in batch. Cards are split as follows:
xhs.helpRule1: Every horizontal rule (---) in the document is a page break: content after it starts on a new card.
xhs.helpRule2: Content before the first rule becomes card 1 (put your title + cover image there); content between two rules becomes one card each.
xhs.helpRule3: Without any rule, cards are split automatically by card height (paragraphs, images, and code blocks are kept intact).
xhs.helpExample:
# Summer Drinks

A wide cover image is recommended here

---

Lemon Sparkling Water
- 1 lemon
- 1 bottle of sparkling water
- Ice cubes

---

Watermelon Juice
- 500g watermelon
- 1 spoon of honey
- A few mint leaves
